equationFormulation.momentum: rho * div(u (x) u) = -grad(p) + div( (mu + mu_t) * (grad(u) + grad(u)^T) )

assumptions: Newtonian fluid with constant density rho and dynamic viscosity mu
Boussinesq eddy-viscosity hypothesis for turbulent stresses tau_ij = 2*mu_t*S_ij - (2/3)*rho*k*delta_ij

equationFormulation.momentum: div(rho * u (x) u + p * I) = div(tau)
equationFormulation.energy: div( (E + p) * u ) = div(tau * u - q)

assumptions: Calorically perfect gas, gamma = 1.4, R = 287.058 J/(kg*K)
governingEquations.validityRange: Experimental only; not qualified for production simulations

pressureVelocityCoupling.formulation: Pressure correction p' derived from discrete continuity defect; Rhie-Chow face flux interpolation to suppress checkerboarding.

discretizationSchemes.name: Second-Order Upwind (SOU)
discretizationSchemes.truncationError: O(Delta x^2) - high-resolution, requires gradient limiters

turbulenceModels.equations: 2-equation RANS: transport of turbulent kinetic energy k and dissipation rate epsilon
turbulenceModels.validityRegime: High Reynolds number attached boundary layers, duct/channel flows

turbulenceModels.equations: 2-equation RANS: blends k-omega near walls with k-epsilon in free stream using F1 blending function
turbulenceModels.wallTreatment: Low-Re integration near wall (y+ ~ 1) with automatic wall blending
turbulenceModels.validityRegime: Adverse pressure gradient flows, boundary layer separation, airfoil profiles

turbulenceModels.equations: 2-equation RANS: transport of k and specific dissipation rate omega
turbulenceModels.validityRegime: Subsonic attached boundary layers; sensitive to freestream omega

turbulenceModels.equations: Filtered Navier-Stokes: eddy viscosity mu_sgs = rho * (Cs * Delta)^2 * |S|

boundaryConditions.velocity: Neumann: zero normal gradient (du/dn = 0) with global mass flow correction
Dirichlet: no-slip u = 0, v = 0, w = 0 (or wall function shear stress tau_w)
